Chapter 1056: Chapter 10 Eye of Myriad Laws and Martial Arts Evolution Road (Please Subscribe)_2

“Although he is a newly ascended Great Venerate, with such a solid foundation, reaching the peak of the Great Venerate level in the future shouldn’t pose much of a problem.” Great Venerate Hongye pondered silently.

At the same time, he glanced at Lord Qingfen. He had known Lord Qingfen for many years, but he had never expected that this old friend would be so skillful in cultivating disciples?

Great Venerate Hongye was well aware that being skilled in one’s own cultivation and in teaching others to cultivate were two entirely different things.

…

The three powerful Great Venerates exchanged some pleasantries before sitting down one after another.

“Great Venerate Hongye, this is the Myriad Formation Crystal.” With a flip of his hand, Lin Yuan brought out the crystalline Myriad Formation Crystal.

At this moment, all the formations contained within the Myriad Formation Crystal had been erased by Lin Yuan.

This was done to maintain the confidentiality of the formations within Qingfen City.

“Hmm.”

Great Venerate Hongye’s eyes lit up as he gazed at the Myriad Formation Crystal for a while before slightly nodding. “It is indeed the Myriad Formation Crystal.”

Currently, he had reached bottlenecks in both the Chaos Flame and Chaos Life Dao paths. He intended to explore other pathways to see if they could provide any insights for his progress.

Among all formation-related treasures, the Myriad Formation Crystal was acclaimed as the source of formations, the culmination of the painstaking efforts of an Array Master.

Even though the formations it once held had been erased, the Myriad Formation Crystal itself was an astonishingly intricate formation.

“This is for you.”

In return, Great Venerate Hongye also produced a storage bracelet filled with the cultivation resources Lin Yuan had requested.

Lin Yuan accepted the bracelet, gave it a quick inspection, and then put it away.

“Great Venerate Hongye, this Myriad Formation Crystal was not obtained through conventional means.” Lin Yuan exchanged glances with Lord Qingfen before speaking.

Up to this point, outsiders only knew that the Purple Dream Domain had intended to stir chaos in Qingfen City, but the specific details, including the price the Purple Dream Domain paid, had not spread widely.

Lord Qingfen and Lin Yuan had not publicized this matter, and as for the Purple Dream Domain? Losing the Myriad Formation Crystal was hardly something they would advertise.

Nevertheless, the fact that the Myriad Formation Crystal had come from the Purple Dream Domain and was likely tied to the high levels of their Ancient Country needed to be disclosed to Great Venerate Hongye.

“How exactly was it obtained?”

Upon hearing this, Great Venerate Hongye became intrigued.

Lin Yuan then briefly recounted the events.

“Hahaha, Qingfen, there’s no need to trouble yourself over such trivial matters.”

Great Venerate Hongye chuckled softly upon hearing the explanation.

He, Hongye, was unrestrained and without attachment, not bound by any Ancient Country decrees. It didn’t matter to him where the Myriad Formation Crystal came from—once it was in his hands, it was his.

“As long as the Great Venerate doesn’t mind.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Some Great Venerates disliked unnecessary trouble, but Great Venerate Hongye seemed not to be one of them.

Next.

Lin Yuan successfully completed the transaction with Great Venerate Hongye.

“Qingfen, you must have expended a great deal of effort to train such a disciple,” Great Venerate Hongye said, transmitting a private message to Lord Qingfen before departing.

“A great deal of… effort?”

Lord Qingfen suddenly felt a little guilty. In truth, aside from providing resources, he hadn’t contributed much at all.

“It seems I should also find a disciple to inherit my teachings…”

Great Venerate Hongye sighed with a vague sense of emotion.

…

Lin Yuan, having completed the transaction, returned to the Sky Burning Court.

“These resources are enough to sustain my cultivation for a long time.”

Lin Yuan scanned the vast amount of resources contained within the storage bracelet. To obtain the Myriad Formation Crystal, Great Venerate Hongye had truly been generous.

Though Lin Yuan was only at the Path Splitting Realm, his consumption of resources far exceeded that of others at the same level. The stronger one was, the greater the energy required to sustain their power. It was an unchanging rule.

“Next, I will seclude myself until… I step into the Mastery Domain.”

Lin Yuan withdrew his wandering thoughts. After witnessing the might of someone like Great Venerate Hongye, he couldn’t help but feel a heavy sense of pressure.

Though his own strength had already reached the threshold of a Great Venerate, he was still far from comparable to a peak Great Venerate such as Great Venerate Hongye.

“Mastery Domain… With my current capabilities, once I step into the Mastery Domain, I shouldn’t be far off from equaling Great Venerate Hongye.”

A confidence swelled within Lin Yuan. If he could advance to the Chaos Realm and fully master his numerous legacies, he might even rival the Heavenly Venerate Great Saints.

…

Chaos Void.

Ancient Ming Chaos Continent, the ‘Fractured World’ of Star Tears.

Sitting cross-legged, Lin Yuan watched as every detail of the world unfolded before his eyes.

“I’ve now refined ninety-nine branches of Martial Tao, each capable of reaching the Twelfth Layer, with a select few even holding the potential to step into the Mastery or Chaos Realms.”

Lin Yuan contemplated silently. Up to this point, the nine strongest branches of Martial Tao had been entrusted to nine supreme figures of human civilization to cultivate. As for the remaining ninety branches? They had already begun spreading among the countless citizens of human civilization.

The ninety-nine branches of Martial Tao encompassed nearly all directions, enough to be utilized by human civilization for an extended period.

“Spreading the Tao…”

Lin Yuan’s eyes closed slightly. In the depths of his mind, he seemed to sense another dimensional space, filled with an endless array of glowing points. Every glow represented a Martial Tao cultivator.

“It’s not enough—not nearly enough.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. As his strength and realm advanced, he increasingly realized that the so-called path of cultivation, the so-called path of evolution, was, at its essence, a journey through darkness.

For those who came after, the road paved by their predecessors provided guidance. But what about those predecessors who first set out to blaze a trail?

They had no clear direction, no predetermined path of correctness. Everything they did was groping through the darkness, risking getting lost at any moment.

During such times, finding one’s “anchor” became immensely critical. And for Lin Yuan, the countless Martial Tao cultivators served as an “anchor” that transcended time, and even life and death.
